capabilities: Intercept Alt+Backspace when the cursor follows Thai or Japanese text
Find word boundaries with the browser's Intl.Segmenter API
Delete exactly one word segment per keypress
Fall through to Obsidian's default behavior for space-delimited languages
extras: Internally implemented as a CodeMirror 6 extension registered with highest priority; no settings or configuration are described.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that fixes Option+Backspace (delete word) for Thai and Japanese text.
problem: Thai and Japanese have no spaces between words, so Obsidian's default Alt+Backspace deletes the entire sentence up to the last space.

relations.evidence: Google Docs and Microsoft Word handle this correctly because they use language-aware word segmentation.

summary: Editor fix that makes Option+Backspace delete one word at a time in Thai and Japanese text using Intl.Segmenter.
